title: SatyaContracts
description: GENERATED from packages/shared-types/schemas by scripts/generate.mjs. Do not edit. All SATYA-EoA contracts (Portal spec §2) in one document.

AffidavitDiff.title: AffidavitDiff
AffidavitDiff.description: RB-05 DiffView payload, GET /v1/cases/{case_id}/affidavit-diff (UI spec §6.3, §7.1; design B1 row 1, C3). M5 output: the sworn Affidavit 2 compared clause by clause with the portal draft for the same AID and AY, and its land and room tables reconciled with the ApplicationSnapshot. Advisory only. Identifier cells that the gateway tokenises (deed holder, deed document no.) are masked.

expected.title: AffidavitExpected
expected.description: Portal-generated Affidavit 2 for this AID and AY.

template_year.description: APH edition the template belongs to, e.g. 2024-27.

printed_no.description: Number as printed in the draft; numbering restarts in the existing-institute block (design B1 row 1).

template_match.description: The sworn copy's heading and AY line identify the expected template.

text_source.title: TextSource
text_source.description: Where the sworn text came from: the PDF text layer, or OCR of a scanned file. Text read by OCR never decides anything.

issuer_sig.description: Filled by the signature check; null when it could not read the file.

uploader_sig.description: Filled by the signature check; null when it could not read the file.

category_list_found.description: null when no category line was found.

no.description: Position in the sworn copy, counted across blocks.

printed_no.description: Number as printed in the sworn copy.

date_order.description: Date order of the template year (design D4).

date_order_fallbacks.description: Dates whose month was impossible in the template order and parsed the other way.

items.title: DeclarationOption
items.description: A strike-through option group in a declaration and the choice the deponent left standing.

decl_no.description: Canonical expected position 1–24; null for an added declaration.

sworn_no.description: Position of the matched declaration in the sworn copy (see sworn.declarations[].no); null for a removed declaration.

columns.description: Field keys in column order, e.g. area_acre; the UI translates them.

key.description: Row key: deed row number (land) or room ID (rooms).

computed_total_acres.description: Land only: sum of sworn deed areas (the portal leaves the total blank).

expected_total_acres.description: Land only: ApplicationSnapshot land.total_area in acres.

room_id_duplicates.description: Room IDs used more than once across the 4 room tables.

article.description: Description of document on the stamp, e.g. 'Article 4 Affidavit'.

stamp.description: Filled by the signature and stamp check from the stamp page; null when no stamp page is found.

dsc_kind.description: Where dsc_date comes from: a real CMS signature or a printed mark (image only).

mark_after_notary.description: A printed signature mark dated after the notarisation (design D1 review case); null when there is no mark.

chronology.description: Application ≤ stamp ≤ notarisation ≤ DSC ≤ upload (design B1 row 1, D1). Filled by the signature and stamp check.

comparison.title: Comparison
comparison.description: Whether the sworn copy was really compared with the portal draft. Added by the API; the page says a copy matches only when state is compared. A scan or an unreadable file is not_compared: OCR text never decides anything.

source.title: ComparisonSource
source.description: Where the sworn text came from, or why there is none.

pending.description: DiffView sections whose checks belong to a later module, so the UI can say so instead of showing an empty panel.

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: Alert with type + subtype (Portal spec §2.9). Institution-facing alerts are limited to missing_info, expired, unresolved.clarification_* and unresolved.compliance_window_*.

ApplicationId.title: ApplicationId
ApplicationId.description: Portal application ID in printed form (design D4). Demo data uses 1-9….

ApplicationSnapshot.title: ApplicationSnapshot
ApplicationSnapshot.description: The Application Report field set as the portal sends it (Portal spec §2.6.1). Every property carries x-handling: K keep, T tokenise (keyed HMAC-SHA256, key never stored with the data), R result only (portal's computed value, D2). Fields marked X must not be sent and do not exist in this model; they are listed in x-rejected-fields and the gateway answers PERSONAL_DATA_REJECTED. Unknown fields are rejected (additionalProperties false) for data minimisation.

overall_deficiency.title: TriState
overall_deficiency.description: Flag only; blank in the report = unknown, never no (design D4).

name.description: Trustee name. Tokenised at the gateway (keyed HMAC-SHA256) before anything is stored; stored as trustee_token.
Chairman/Secretary name, used only for the M6 signer check (§2.8). Tokenised at the gateway (keyed HMAC-SHA256) before anything is stored; stored as signatory_token.

intake_approved.description: Intake approved for the last 2 AYs.

holder.description: Deed holder. Tokenised at the gateway (keyed HMAC-SHA256) before anything is stored; stored as holder_token.

document_no.description: Deed document number. Tokenised at the gateway (keyed HMAC-SHA256) before anything is stored; stored as deed_token.

bank.title: SnapshotBank
bank.description: Account number is X (rejected), never part of this model.

faculty_id.description: Portal Faculty ID (1- + 9–11 digits). Reveal only via a logged official action (AU-04). Tokenised at the gateway (keyed HMAC-SHA256) before anything is stored; stored as faculty_token.

is_duplicate.description: Portal's own within-portal duplicate flag (D2); never recomputed.

pan_validation.description: Portal's PAN validation result only (D2); the PAN itself is X.

deficiency_report.title: DeficiencyReportResult
deficiency_report.description: Portal Deficiency Report result, imported not recomputed (D2, guard rail 8).

principal_eligibility.description: The only HOI-derived value SATYA keeps (HOI personal details are X).

CaseVerification.title: CaseVerification
CaseVerification.description: RB-06 Verification panel data for one case (UI spec §6.4, §7.2): one row per document with exactly one of the six labels (or not_applicable), the two independent signature badges (§4.3) and the source checked. Advisory only; a valid uploader signature never makes a document verified (Portal §2.6.3). Demo chains are always shown as TEST TRUST ANCHOR and mock sources as MOCK SOURCE (guard rail 10).

trust_anchor_label.description: Label of the configured trust anchor: 'TEST TRUST ANCHOR' in the demo, the CCA root in production.

format_type.description: T = AICTE template, E = external, P = portal data (design B).

issuer_profile.description: Annexure-14 issuer profile id; null when none is recorded.

adapter_mode.description: Same values as CheckSource.mode; every mock result is shown as MOCK SOURCE.

label.description: Document label = most severe check outcome (Portal §2.6.3); not_applicable only for self-issued documents (UI §6 enum).

response_ref.description: Hash or receipt of the source response; null when no source answered.

actions.description: Suggested next steps for the official (UI §7.2); the workbench has no control that runs them.

checks.description: The document's VerificationResult.checks[] (Portal §2.7), for the panel's detail view.

read.description: How the file was read; the plain sentence for a scan or an unreadable file comes from it.

flags.description: Findings raised on this document (Portal §2.6.4); additive to UI §6.4 so RB-06 can show findings no other P1 screen shows yet (e.g. UDIN).

CategoryName.title: CategoryName
CategoryName.description: An application category as printed in the affidavit's numbered category line, e.g. EoA Only.

check_ref.description: Links the check to the flag it raised (Flag.check_ref), e.g. m6:STAMP-CHRONO:chronology:order.

signed_at.description: Signature checks: signing time claimed in the CMS signature (the validation moment).

trust_anchor_label.description: Signature checks: the anchor the chain built to; demo chains are always 'TEST TRUST ANCHOR' (guard rail 10).

DeclarationBlock.title: DeclarationBlock
DeclarationBlock.description: core = 19 core declarations; existing_institute = 5 'Existing Institute' declarations; extra = a block the 2024-27 draft does not print (e.g. a 2023-24-style Increase-in-Intake block).

Disposition.title: Disposition
Disposition.description: An official's recorded decision on a flag (Portal spec §2.6.5; UI spec §4.2). No action changes regulatory status; undo is a new ledger entry.

by_user_ref.description: Opaque user reference (Keycloak subject), never a name.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: A document in a case (Portal spec §2.6.2). classified_type comes from body text / issuer, never heading, filename or uploader label (decision #15); when it differs from declared_type a suspected_anomaly.document_misclassified flag is raised.

format_type.title: FormatType
format_type.description: T = AICTE template, E = external, P = portal data (design B).

EventEnvelope.title: EventEnvelope
EventEnvelope.description: Event envelope for both directions (Portal spec §2.3). Every inbound type is a proposed hook that the mock portal implements (guard rail 2). Outbound events must carry advisory: true and regulatory_effect: none (guard rail 1). Consumers ignore unknown top-level fields (§2.12).

deep_link.description: Opaque path; no personal data, no tokens.

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description: All inbound and outbound event types.

Flag.title: Flag
Flag.description: An evidence-linked finding (Portal spec §2.6.4). Every flag cites rule_id + rule_version + aph_clause + aph_edition (guard rail 6). Anomaly/forgery-type flags carry preliminary_indicator: true (PS FR2).

PermanentId.title: PermanentId
PermanentId.description: Portal permanent ID in printed form (design D4).

PrintedSection.title: PrintedSection
PrintedSection.description: Portal-computed section kept as printed, display only (D2).

ReadNote.title: ReadNote
ReadNote.description: How a file was read: the PDF text layer, OCR of a scan, or not at all. The wording of the sentence is a translated template picked by `variant`. Text read by OCR never decides anything.

reason_code.description: Short code for auditors, for example SCAN_IMAGE_ONLY. The code is shared by a scan that was read and a scan that was not.

variant.description: Key of the plain sentence, for example scan_read, low_confidence, scan_not_attempted.

values.description: Numbers the sentence mentions (confidence, threshold, pages).

Region.title: Region
Region.description: Evidence region on a page, normalised 0–1.

RiskBand.title: RiskBand
RiskBand.description: Risk band (decision #20). Orders review only; never a 0–100 score; never shown to the institution.

flooring.description: Completion of flooring, as printed (e.g. Ready).

SignatureCheck.title: SignatureCheck
SignatureCheck.description: One of the two independent signature checks (Portal spec §2.8, UI spec §4.3). An image-only mark is never verified (decision #16).

has_byte_range.description: true only for a real CMS signature (/ByteRange).

trust_anchor_label.description: Demo chain anchors are always 'TEST TRUST ANCHOR' (guard rail 10).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with offset (format-checked; Pydantic AwareDatetime); stored UTC, shown IST.

VerificationLabel.title: VerificationLabel
VerificationLabel.description: The six PS verification labels (Portal spec §2.6.3). Document label = most severe check outcome, in x-precedence order (most severe first). `verified` also requires at least one authenticity check; a valid uploader DSC never makes a document verified.

VerificationResult.title: VerificationResult
VerificationResult.description: Per-document verification with all checks (Portal spec §2.7). Every mock result is shown as MOCK SOURCE (guard rail 10).

basis_note.description: Required when an official resolves the label.

YoyVerdict.title: YoyVerdict
YoyVerdict.description: M13 year-over-year verdict (design C4a): explained by an approved application, or a discrepancy.
